correctness.rationale: A locally uniformly convergent Fourier mask product gives exact factor zeros; nonvanishing summable tails preclude hidden zeros. The nested dyadic factor cosets imply exact vanishing count 1+min(2-adic valuations). Exact lattice scale identities and disk-area error O(R+1) prove all density claims, with no finite-to-infinite extrapolation. The packaged deterministic checker independently passed examples of order 1–4, integer disk counts and local windings.
